Scheduled maintenance — September 14, 2026

We are performing scheduled maintenance on the ticketing API. Purchases may be unavailable during the window below. Existing orders are unaffected, e-tickets remain valid, and barcode entry at venues will continue to work throughout the maintenance period.

  • 01:30 UTC — Read-only mode enabled for the order API; purchase attempts show a friendly notice.
  • 02:00 UTC — Full maintenance window begins; API returns 503 with Retry-After headers.
  • 03:30 UTC — Scheduled verification of payment webhooks and seat-inventory sync.
  • 04:00 UTC — Expected completion and restoration of full purchase flows.

Common questions

Will my tickets still work?
Yes. All e-tickets issued before the maintenance window remain valid and scannable at the venue.
I was mid-checkout when the site went down. What now?
No charge was made. After 04:00 UTC your seat hold will be restored for an additional 30 minutes; look for the "resume checkout" banner.
How do I reach a human?
Support chat and phone lines stay open around the clock; see the contact section below for current wait times.

Need help now?

Contact support at support@ticketwire.example or call 1-800-555-0199. Current average wait: 6 minutes. Wait times are longer than usual during maintenance windows, and our status page posts live incident updates every 15 minutes.
